features.title: Scenes become reusable encounters
features.description: Add locally saved scenes to a world, place multiple buildings or encounters, and move, rotate or elevate each placement as a group. Encounter templates and imported geometry travel inside your world file.

features.title: Tables and underground levels
features.description: Choose 3 × 3, 4 × 4, 6 × 4 or 8 × 4 ft tables, a dining table, or a custom size. Add named levels, hide upper layers to work underground, and save a level as a reusable scene.

features.title: Your world stays on your PC
features.description: Worlds use separate local project files, recovery and backups. Existing scenes still open. Use Fit table to see the whole layout; every level is included when exporting a print pack.
